area: the Dolphin's racing AI and Switchback
summary: Regatta now flies the Dolphin's Switchback-trained boost drive (new DolphinAIBoostPolicy_Regatta, a copy of the trained values), and the Dolphin's Drift Charge rate is re-fit to x1.25 -> x2.76 to keep it in the Regatta field
why: Regatta flew the untrained base policy, which split its races into two lines by seed; the trained drive cuts the seed spread 2.5-3x. Switchback rungs re-checked at the new charge: I1 82-91, I2 115-118, I3 109-136, I4 211-235 s
